description: Andorra Banc Agrícol Reig (Andbank), SA was created in August 2001 as a result of the merger between Banc Agrícol i Comercial d’Andorra, SA (foundedin 1930) and Banca Reig, SA (founded in 1956). Andbank operates as a universal bank providing retail, private, corporate banking, asset and wealth management services in Andorra and internationally.
services: retail banking; private banking; corporate banking; asset management; wealth management; wealth planning;
clients: natural persons; high net worth individuals; companies;
products: current accounts; salary accounts; savings accounts; pension plans; mutual funds; investment funds; consumer loans; mortgage loans; structured products;
summary: Andorra Banc Agrícol Reig, SA is the 1st largest bank in Andorra in terms of total assets. In 2020 its total assets were 5 227,06 mln EUR, providing the bank with the market share of 34.46%. In 2020 the bank's net income was 30,26 mln EUR. Andorra Banc Agrícol Reig, SA is rated by Fitch. Long-term credit rating assigned to the bank by Fitch is BBB (good credit quality). Andorra Banc Agrícol Reig, SA participates in the deposit guarantee scheme of Andorra.This scheme covers accounts up to 100,000 EUR per bank per depositor.

description: Incorporated in 1949, Crèdit Andorrà provides retail, corporate banking and private banking, asset and wealth management on an international scale. Crèdit Andorrà also offers financial advising and insurance products.
services: retail banking; private banking; wealth management; business banking; corporate and investment banking; wealth planning;
clients: natural persons; high net worth individuals; self-employed professionals; companies;

description: Incorporated in 1958 as Banca Coma, it changed its nameto Banc Internacional d’Andorra, SA in 1970 and to Mora Banc Group, SA in November 2011.MoraBanc Grup offers services in commercial banking, private banking and asset management, investment banking, wealth management and investment funds, and insurance, in addition to offering its customers differentiated and exclusive products.Mora Banc Grup and Mora Banc, SAU operate together under the MoraBanc brand name and they present their financial statements and other data in a consolidated manner.
services: retail banking; private banking; asset management; online brokerage; business banking;
clients: natural persons; children and minors; public employees; self-employed professionals; high net worth individuals; entrepreneurs; companies;
products: current accounts; junior accounts; debit cards; credit cards; deposit accounts; combined deposits; savings plans; investment funds; consumer loans; car loans; mortgage loans;

description: BancSabadell d’Andorra was established in Andorra 2000 as a result of the alliance between the Banc Sabadell group and a consortium of Andorran business owners. BancSabadell d’Andorra offers full range of banking services - retail and corporate banking, private bankings and brokerage services.
services: retail banking; private banking; asset management; corporate banking;
products: current accounts; debit cards; salary accounts; junior accounts; professional accounts; savings accounts; investment funds; pension plans; consumer loans; vehicle loans; mortgage loans; bank guarantees;
summary: Banc Sabadell d’Andorra, SA is the 4th largest bank in Andorra in terms of total assets. In 2020 its total assets were 1 037,53 mln EUR, providing the bank with the market share of 6.84%. Banc Sabadell d’Andorra, SA participates in the deposit guarantee scheme of Andorra.This scheme covers accounts up to 100,000 EUR per bank per depositor.
